answer: Bridge dependencies. Each submission must cite two products from distinct identities active last epoch, and each cited identity must countersign; upstreams drawn more than 60 percent from one cluster halve the weight. Both sides sign the cipher on each edge, so a farm cannot mint its own upstreams, and a forged countersignature forfeits the poster's pigment bond. Cloning thirty identities needs thirty sets of genuine signatures each epoch, costing more than running them honestly. Citations expire after three epochs. No citation, no weight.
